purpose: Independent classical-MD check (MEAM) of the GB10's MACE melting point and latent heat.
status: inputs only; NOT submitted. Ask Madhan before submitting any Nebius job.
engine: LAMMPS (needs the MEAM package: check `lmp -h | grep -i meam` on the Nebius image)

potential.citation: H. Zhou, D.E. Dickel, M.I. Baskes, S. Mun, and M. Asle Zaeem (2021), "A modified embedded-atom method interatomic potential for bismuth", Modelling Simul. Mater. Sci. Eng. 29(6), 065008.
caveats: The paper's abstract says the potential reproduces the melting point of pure Bi, so the classical check is partly fitted to the experimental value for Bi; say so when comparing.

structure.source: coolorbit/sim/alloys.py ELEMENT_CRYSTALS (Donohue, The Structures of the Elements, 1974; alpha-Ga: Sharma & Donohue 1962). Starting lattice constants; NPT relaxes them.

melting_point_guess.source: data/calibration/tier1.json (NIST Certificate of Analysis, Standard Reference Material 2235 'Bismuth for Thermal Analysis' (2015), https://tsapps.nist.gov/srmext/certificates/archives/2235.pdf)
melting_point_guess.use: ONLY to place the temperature bracket. Not a reference value: the calibration references live in data/calibration/ (Teammate 1).

jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Bi-coexist-T435.6.lammps -var T 435.6 -var Tprep 544.6 -var Tmelt 1633.8 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Bi-coexist-T490.1.lammps -var T 490.1 -var Tprep 544.6 -var Tmelt 1633.8 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Bi-coexist-T544.6.lammps -var T 544.6 -var Tprep 544.6 -var Tmelt 1633.8 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Bi-coexist-T599.lammps -var T 599 -var Tprep 544.6 -var Tmelt 1633.8 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Bi-coexist-T653.5.lammps -var T 653.5 -var Tprep 544.6 -var Tmelt 1633.8 -var seed 2026

jobs.status: BLOCKED until this potential's own melting point is known from the coexistence jobs (latent heat is defined at the model's Tm, not the experimental one)
jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.latent.lmp -log log_Bi-latent-solid.lammps -var phase solid -var T TM_MEAM_K -var seed 2026

jobs.status: BLOCKED until this potential's own melting point is known from the coexistence jobs (latent heat is defined at the model's Tm, not the experimental one)
jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.latent.lmp -log log_Bi-latent-liquid.lammps -var phase liquid -var T TM_MEAM_K -var seed 2026

latent.protocol: solid vs liquid enthalpy at Tm

analysis.latent: python ../analyze.py latent h_solid_TTM_MEAM_K.dat h_liquid_TTM_MEAM_K.dat --log-solid log_Bi-latent-solid.lammps --log-liquid log_Bi-latent-liquid.lammps

if_bracket_missed: all melting -> shift the bracket down by 20%; all freezing -> up by 20% (same rule as the GB10 Simulator), then refine around the crossover with 4 temperatures 2% apart.
